purpose: Prevent retrospective references, namespace collisions, semantic lookalikes, and incomplete searches from being promoted to originating assignments for continuity identifiers.

required_origin_predicates.immutable_locator: A stable commit, blob, archived document revision, or retained source object identifies the candidate.
required_origin_predicates.explicit_assignment: The source explicitly assigns the identifier rather than merely mentioning, rejecting, migrating, or auditing it.
required_origin_predicates.namespace_agreement: The identifier belongs to the continuity namespace and is not a suffix or label collision from another system.
required_origin_predicates.owner_agreement: The source assigns the identifier under continuity_mining or an approved predecessor authority.
required_origin_predicates.semantic_role_agreement: The assigned object has the same durable memory role claimed by the identifier.
required_origin_predicates.temporal_precedence: The candidate predates known retrospective controls and later unresolved-status records.
required_origin_predicates.source_class_allowed: The source is an approved repository, decision-log, language-lexicon, project-document, or privacy-reviewed chat-history object.
required_origin_predicates.coverage_sufficient: The search coverage is exhaustive for the source class being used to declare an identifier unlocated.

resolution_rules.located: All predicates except coverage_sufficient must be true, with no contradictory immutable candidate of equal or stronger authority.
resolution_rules.unlocated_after_exhaustive_coverage: No candidate satisfies the origin predicates and coverage_sufficient is true for every approved source class in scope.
resolution_rules.unresolved: Any required predicate is false, unknown, contradictory, or coverage remains incomplete.
resolution_rules.rejected_collision: namespace_agreement is false even if text similarity or identifier suffix matches.
resolution_rules.retrospective_reference: explicit_assignment or temporal_precedence is false because the source audits, rejects, migrates, or discusses an already-existing identifier.

fail_closed: A text match alone cannot resolve provenance.
Automation completion prose is a lead, not an immutable origin object.
File Library suffix matches cannot cross namespace boundaries.
Incomplete branch or source-class coverage cannot support an unlocated-final classification.
Conflicting immutable candidates remain unresolved until authority and chronology are reconciled.
reversibility: Additive contract; revert this commit without changing canonical queue or historical artifacts.
